title: Websocket doesn't seem to work with React ?
body:
### First Check - [X] I added a very descriptive title here. - [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it. - [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search. - [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information. - [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer. - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic). - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui). - [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc). ### Commit to Help - [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆 ### Example Code ```python from fastapi import FastAPI, WebSocket app = FastAPI() @app.websocket("/ws") async def test(ws: WebSocket): await ws.accept() >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>> React snippet >>>>>>>>>>>> function Foo() { // Works when web socket is created outside // const ws2 = new WebSocket("ws://0.0.0.0:8000/ws") // ws.onopen = () => {console.log("outside")} useEffect(() => { const ws = new WebSocket("ws://0.0.0.0:8000/ws") ws.onopen = () => {console.log("inside")} //Doesn't print return () => {ws.close()} }, []) return (
) } ``` ### Description Hi, I'm trying to use websocket to connect the fastapi app with react. In React, if I put the WebSocket creation code outside of useEffect, it works (but I don't want to do that in production because a new socket gets created every render). But if I put the WebSocket logic inside useEffect, the onopen log is never called. When WebSocket is created outside of useEffect, I can see the fast api log a connection, but when created inside useEffect, the fast api logs show no new connection. I then tried replacing my url with a random ws server like "wss://ws.ifelse.io" and this connects fine both in and outside of useEffect. Is FastAPI's connection somehow unique ? Could any fastapi expert or React expert give me some advice / ideas ? Thanks ### Operating System Windows ### Operating System Details _No response_ ### FastAPI Version 0.115.14 ### Pydantic Version 2.11.7 ### Python Version 3.13.2 ### Additional Context _No response_

answer.body: @luzzodev  Hi, I figured it out. I had to use "ws://localhost:8000" as the address instead of "ws://0.0.0.0:8000". The fast api server says listening on '0.0.0.0:8000' so I wrongly assumed that was the address. Thanks for giving it a try.
